dedupe_keys.name: mowe it management of weather events in the transport system eu fp7 2012 2014

description: MOWE-IT was an EU Seventh Framework Programme project (1 October 2012 to 30 September 2014, total cost about 2.35 million euros, EU contribution about 1.64 million) on reducing the vulnerability of the European transport system to extreme weather and natural disasters. Its objective was to assess how air and surface transport could substitute for each other's services during curtailments, shutdowns and capacity shortages, building on the WEATHER and EWENT projects; to check how passenger and freight companies comply with EU user-rights legislation on delays and cancellations; and to propose guidelines for cross-modal decision making, capacity planning and reserves, plus incentives and policy instruments. It had nine work packages. Partners included VTT, DLR, Fraunhofer, KIT, the University of Birmingham, Vaisala, the Finnish Meteorological Institute and via donau. Coverage: European transport modes. Format and access: CORDIS fact sheet. Licence and cost: free to read. Caveats: the fact sheet summarises aims; outputs must be found in project deliverables. It supports resilience and emergency response planning across modes. It relates to the Network Rail WRCCA plans and the PIARC road case study collection in the catalogue.
